changed: On very wide screens, icons, spacing and panels now grow with the text instead of staying small beside it.
My Gear keeps whole names on wide screens, and its divider sits beside the panel and stays under your pointer as you drag.
In My Gear, Add to and its folder read as one phrase, and gear with no icon gets a quiet placeholder so names line up.
On phones, the My Gear sheet is the same height signed out as it is with your gear in it.
The Add a trail panel is shorter, and its labels line up with what you type.
Microspikes, crampons and snowshoes show a boot and sit under Footwear in My Gear.
fixed: Lanterns and flashlights no longer show a headlamp icon.
